_comment: Mutation testing (TICP 2.1). Each mutant runs the whole suite through node:test; the site's copied modules in src/site/ are the site's and are not mutated here. Thresholds: scripts/mutate.mjs holds each critical module (its CRITICAL list) to 80, every other module to 60, and the whole to 60.
_comment_hangs: A run must end itself (TICP 2.1, rule 7): --test-timeout cancels a hung test and --test-force-exit exits past open handles, because on Windows Stryker's kill of a timed-out run can fail and leave its process tree behind (229 processes, 25 GB on 2026-10-01). timeoutMS sits above the test timeout so the run ends itself first; concurrency is held to 4 to keep memory headroom.
